dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Category 2 on Feb 22 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001147\_3](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001147) Category 2 during the period Feb 22 2025-Feb 22 2025 in Papua New Guinea. The center of the storm was located near latitude 14.0 longitude 151.2. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
